description: This Java class implements DHL shipment services, including rate estimation, registration, and shipment confirmation, using DHL's ShipIT XML API. It handles request creation, sending, response parsing, error handling, and label/image processing for DHL shipments within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: DhlServices
classes.description: Provides methods for DHL shipment rate estimation, registration, and shipment confirmation via DHL's ShipIT XML API within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: DhlConnectException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling DHL connection errors.

methods.name: sendDhlRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to DHL's API endpoint and returns the XML response as a string.

methods.name: dhlRateEstimate
methods.description: Obtains a rate estimate from DHL for a shipment, supporting only one package per shipment.

methods.name: handleDhlRateResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL's XML response to extract rate estimate details and errors.

methods.name: dhlRegisterInquire
methods.description: Registers a DHL account to obtain a shipping key.

methods.name: handleDhlRegisterResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL registration response XML to retrieve the shipping key.

methods.name: dhlShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms a shipment with DHL, retrieves tracking number and label, and updates shipment segment records.

methods.name: handleDhlShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL shipment confirmation response to extract tracking number, label image, and update records.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Creates an XML document for DHL access request using configuration parameters.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Processes XML response elements to extract and record error messages.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for DHL shipment gateway, either from database or properties file.
